pages.title: Water, Lava, Snow & Fire
pages.text: A Water Bucket creates a water environment; a Lava Bucket creates lava and deals lava-style damage; a Powder Snow Bucket causes freezing; Flint and Steel creates fire. Effects stay inside the cage and do not spread fluid or fire outside.

pages.title: Cactus & Lightning
pages.text: Cactus appears at the cage floor and deals vanilla cactus-style damage. A Lightning Rod selects the lightning environment without adding a model; when occupied, the cage strikes that prisoner roughly every 10 seconds.

pages.title: Golden Apple & Milk
pages.text: A Golden Apple continuously grants Regeneration III and Resistance I while the prisoner remains inside. Cage-provided effects end immediately after release or a state change. A Milk Bucket clears every special environment and restores ordinary imprisonment.
